changes: Added note: Lamjung is given as the scribe's residence (lamajum vasnyā), so it is only inferred as the place of copying; the name is normalized from 'pitāmvara' (v for b, short i).
Date, era (VS 1902 = c. 1845 CE), scribe role and title confirmed.

notes: The era is not named ('śrīsaṃvat … sālamā'). A Nepali colophon with year 1902 points to Vikrama Saṃvat, which matches the catalogue: 1902 − 57 = 1845 CE, possibly 1845/46. 'lamajum vasnyā' (residing in Lamjung) gives the scribe's residence, not explicitly the place of copying. The catalogue's 'Place of Copying: Lamajuṅ' is therefore an inference. The name is written 'pitāmvara' (Pitāmbara with v for b) and normalized to Pītāmbara. The phrase 'lekhyāko pustaka' only means 'book written by', so no owner or commissioner is stated.
